items.name: b-hornbreaker-horn-rush
items.subject: HORN RUSH, the Hornbreaker's charge: the hero's great curved black horn and armoured head drive forward diagonally toward the viewer, lowered like a battering ram, with dust and orange-white speed streaks trailing behind and a burst of impact sparks at the horn's tip. Energy colour: hot orange and white.

items.name: b-hornbreaker-overwhelm
items.subject: OVERWHELM, the Hornbreaker's battering blows that stack: his steel-and-brass hammer head smashes down from the upper left onto a cracking dark enemy carapace, with three crescent shock-rings stacked one behind the other, each one brighter. Energy colour: deep red-orange impact light.

items.name: b-hornbreaker-steadfast
items.subject: STEADFAST AURA, the Hornbreaker's aura that heals nearby allies: a royal-blue and brass beetle war banner standing upright in the centre, topped by a black curved horn emblem, with a calm ring of warm golden light radiating around it. Energy colour: warm gold.

items.name: b-hornbreaker-colossus
items.subject: COLOSSUS, the Hornbreaker's ultimate: the hero grown into a towering living siege engine, seen from a very low angle looking up, his great horn and armoured shoulders filling the frame, heavier brass plates bolted on, steam venting from his armour, the violet glass core of his hammer blazing. Energy colour: blazing gold and orange with violet in the hammer core.

items.name: b-forgemaster-bolt-turret
items.subject: BOLT TURRET, the Forgemaster deploys a turret: a squat brass and dark-steel multi-barrel repeater turret on three splayed steel legs just slammed into the ground, its barrels firing toward the upper right with bright muzzle flashes and orange tracers, a royal-blue armour plate on its front. Energy colour: orange muzzle fire.

items.name: b-forgemaster-overclock
items.subject: OVERCLOCK, makes an ally attack and move much faster: a big brass pressure gauge whose needle is slammed far into the red, behind it brass gears spinning with motion blur and jets of white steam bursting out. Energy colour: hot orange-red and white steam.

items.name: b-forgemaster-field-forge
items.subject: FIELD FORGE, the Forgemaster's aura that armours allies and repairs machines: a brass anvil in the centre with a forge hammer resting on it and a royal-blue armour plate glowing hot orange at its edge, a calm ring of warm forge light around it. Energy colour: warm orange forge glow.

items.name: b-forgemaster-forgefall
items.subject: FORGEFALL, the Forgemaster's ultimate: a huge brass crucible tipping as it plunges from above, pouring a torrent of glowing molten metal down onto the ground below where it splashes into a burning pool. Energy colour: molten orange and yellow-white.

items.name: b-coilkeeper-arc-lash
items.subject: ARC LASH, the Coilkeeper's spell: a jagged chain of brilliant violet lightning leaps from the brass coil-tip of her lantern-staff (lower left) and forks across the frame, jumping between three dark silhouetted enemy insects. Energy colour: violet and electric blue-white.

items.name: b-coilkeeper-overload
items.subject: OVERLOAD, detonates an enemy's magic: a dark enemy insect silhouette in the centre bursts apart in a violet-white explosion that rips the magic out of it, violet energy sucked out in streaks and then blasting outward in a ring. Energy colour: violet and white.

items.name: b-coilkeeper-recharge
items.subject: RECHARGE, restores allies' mana and shields them: the Coilkeeper's brass lantern held up in the centre, a calm flow of blue-violet light pouring out of its glass and spiralling outward into a translucent shimmering dome shield. Energy colour: cool blue and soft violet.

items.name: b-coilkeeper-unbottled
items.subject: UNBOTTLED, the Coilkeeper's ultimate, the one time a beetle lets substance loose: her brass lantern shatters in the centre, glass shards flying, and a towering violet storm vortex erupts from it, spiralling upward with arcs of lightning, dark enemy silhouettes lifted into the swirl. Energy colour: intense violet, magenta-white core.
